name: Wyndham Rewards Earner Business Card

apr.notes: 0% promotional APR on Wyndham Timeshare Purchases for 6 billing cycles. Variable APR for purchases is 19.49% to 29.49%. Variable APR for cash advances is 29.74%. APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Minimum monthly interest charge $1. Balance transfer fee: 3% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 3% (min. $10).

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

credit_required.notes: Not everyone will qualify for the Visa Signature credit card; if credit criteria not met, may receive a Platinum card with varying benefits.

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 on all other purchases.

categories.label: Hotels by Wyndham and eligible gas purchases
Eligible marketing, advertising and utility purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Free Nights require 7,500-30,000 points per bedroom. Redeem 20% fewer points for free nights (starting at 6,000 points). Points Payback allows redeeming points for statement credit on purchases within last 90 days. Can redeem for merchandise, gift cards, experiences.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 45,000 bonus points after spending $3,000 on purchases in the first 90 days and also earn 55,000 bonus points after spending $500 at Hotels by Wyndham in the first 180 days. Total up to 100,000 bonus points.

benefits.title: Wyndham Rewards DIAMOND Member Level
benefits.description: Automatically receive a Wyndham Rewards DIAMOND member level and enjoy suite upgrades, welcome amenity at check-in at select hotels, and more.

benefits.title: Complimentary Emerald Club Executive status with National
benefits.description: Enjoy access to the Executive area and so much more.

benefits.title: $65 Wholesale Membership Club Credit
benefits.description: Enjoy an annual $65 statement credit on eligible Wholesale Membership clubs.

benefits.title: $50 Accounting Software Credit
benefits.description: Enjoy up to a $50 statement credit back each calendar year after making qualifying software purchases with your card.

benefits.title: Anniversary Bonus
benefits.description: Receive 15,000 bonus points each anniversary year after payment of your annual fee.

benefits.title: Complimentary Employee Cards
benefits.description: Complimentary employee cards offer you more control over business expenses and improved tracking by adding employees to your account at no additional cost.

benefits.title: Cardmember Booking Discount
benefits.description: Save even more on Standard Rate for stays at participating Hotels by Wyndham and hotels in Wyndham Travel Bundles.

benefits.title: Save 15% When You Buy Points
benefits.description: Enjoy a 15% discount-or best available offer-when you purchase points with your Wyndham Rewards Earner Business Card.

benefits.title: Redeem Points for a Statement Credit
benefits.description: Points Payback allows you to redeem points for a statement credit for purchases made within the last 90 days.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for charges you did not authorize.

other: Complimentary Emerald Club Executive status with National

notes: Verified from official issuer page (Visa Signature, issued by Barclays Bank Delaware). Renamed to 'Wyndham Rewards Earner Business Card' to disambiguate from the Plus (consumer) card. Filled the 8X (Hotels by Wyndham and gas) and 5X (marketing, advertising and utilities) bonus tiers, which were empty placeholders; base earn is 1X. Network corrected from mastercard to visa. Annual fee corrected from $0 to $149. Signup bonus corrected to 100,000 points.
